_why: The recovered agy response is the agent's answer passed through whole and unbounded. Under the wrapper's global pipefail, `printf ... | grep -aq` reported a MATCH as 141 once the response cleared the ~64 KB pipe buffer, so _cmd_exec blanked a verdict it had already recovered -- failing closed on exactly the empty-final-message case the recovery path exists to serve. Measured 2026-09-01: 240 KB carrying `VERDICT: COMPLIANT` discarded, the same text at 18 B kept.
_provenance: Same defect class as the wait frame gates (commit 282a3a5). That fix's sweep recorded this site as ruled out; the rule-out argued about re-reading the log rather than about the size of the response, and a controlled probe falsified it.

mutations.name: recovered-verdict-uses-pipe
mutations._mechanism: Restore printf | grep -aq inside the extracted predicate. A large response carrying a verdict is then read as carrying none, and _cmd_exec blanks it.
